title: Deck template — after Gamma Fair Test
brief: Example deck template following Gamma's Fair Test: white ground, isometric dioramas, one rainbow color and labelled pill per method stage, heavy rounded headings, mono measurements. Shown on a content slide (hypothesis).

artboards.title: Fair Test · faithful
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the Gamma template (bright, white, rounded); friendly for classes and science topics, but does not read as Gentle

artboards.title: Fair Test × Gentle
artboards.tradeoff: Same structure (stage pills, diorama, mono measures) on the Gentle palette; reads as a Gentle product, but less toy-bright than the original
